sentences.text: Villa Park is a football stadium in Aston , Birmingham , England , with a seating capacity of 42,682 .	Birmingham	Birmingham	football	association football	stadium	stadium	Aston	Aston	seating capacity	seating capacity
It has been the home of Aston Villa Football Club since 1897 .	Aston	Aston	Aston Villa Football Club	Aston Villa F.C.

The ground is less than a mile from both Witton and Aston railway stations and has hosted sixteen England internationals at senior level , the first in 1899 and the most recent in 2005 .	Aston	Aston	Witton	Witton railway station	England internationals	England national football team
Villa Park has hosted 55 FA Cup semi-finals , more than any other stadium .	stadium	stadium	FA Cup	Football Association Challenge Cup

In 1897 , Aston Villa moved into the Aston Lower Grounds , a sports ground in a Victorian amusement park in the former grounds of Aston Hall , a Jacobean stately home .	Aston	Aston	Victorian	Victorian era	amusement park	amusement park	Aston Hall	Aston Hall	Jacobean	Jacobean architecture

The stadium has gone through various stages of renovation and development , resulting in the current stand configuration of the Holte End , Trinity Road Stand , North Stand and Doug Ellis Stand .	stadium	stadium
The club has initial planning permission to redevelop the North Stand , which will increase the capacity of Villa Park from 42,682 to about 50,000 .	planning permission	planning permission
Before 1914 , a cycling track ran around the perimeter of the pitch where regular cycling meetings were hosted as well as athletic events .	pitch	football pitch	athletic events	sport of athletics

Aside from football-related uses , the stadium has seen various concerts staged along with other sporting events including boxing matches and international rugby league and rugby union matches .	football	association football	stadium	stadium	other sporting events	multi-purpose stadium	rugby league	rugby league	rugby union	rugby union
In 1999 , the last ever final of the UEFA Cup Winners ' Cup took place at Villa Park .

Villa Park also hosted the 2012 FA Community Shield , as Wembley Stadium was in use for the final of the Olympic football tournament .	football	association football	2012 FA Community Shield	2012 FA Community Shield	Wembley Stadium	Wembley Stadium	Olympic football tournament	Football at the 2012 Summer Olympics
